evidence_layer: Offline audit of ended simulation JSON and recorded source/receive metadata; not a new runtime validation

parent_action.acceptance: Feedback and active owned handle establish acceptance, but a separately timestamped acceptance response is not recorded.
parent_action.scope: Submitted operation is PICK, while executed/confirmed stage is PREGRASP; FIRST_STAGE_HOLD_CONFIRMED is feedback with parent handle still unresolved, not a completed PICK result.

execution_window.definition: Observer-received EXECUTING_FIRST_MTC_STAGE feedback to first observer-received FIRST_STAGE_HOLD_CONFIRMED feedback; not exact physical motion boundaries

first_stage_evidence.endpoint_source: fresh arm_left_controller/controller_state reference/desired after six journal terminal successes

child_actions.event_time_limitation: Top-level journal issued_at/valid_until are resource lease times, not child event timestamps. Child submission/response/terminal event ROS and steady times are absent. Their order and UUIDs are usable; do not report the lease issued_at as action latency or ACK time.

navigation_revocation_before_arm.scope: Resource journal revocation readback ordering, not six EnvelopeApplyStatus acknowledgments.

guard.top_level_source_ns_semantics: null because message has no header; data.stamp is guard publication ROS time, joint_stamp/base_stamp are source observation times
guard.interpretation: Two active/unhealthy WAITING_FOR_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE samples precede EXECUTING feedback; no unhealthy active guard sample observed inside that feedback window. After guard deactivation healthy=false while reason retains EXECUTION_WITHIN_BOUNDS; do not classify inactive=false health as a new execution fault. Maxima are sampled published guard metrics, not continuous hard bounds.

envelope_ack_audit.schema_provenance: Current source and installed generated Python schema read offline, both lack mode; historical runtime AttributeError independently demonstrates absence in the message used for this run. Schema files are not an asserted frozen historical endpoint introspection.
envelope_ack_audit.interpretation: Recorded envelope was navigation_allowed=false and WAITING_FOR six consumers then five (protection no longer in pending reason); this coordinator reason is not a raw six-ACK proof. Callback builds dict before append and fails on msg.mode, so zero saved ACKs means recording failed, not that no ACK was published.

cleanup_and_release.quarantine_event_time: NOT_RECORDED; lease valid_until=80.902s is an expiry bound, not the journal event observation time.
cleanup_and_release.interpretation: Normal release is not proved. stop() raised the same ACK AttributeError during cleanup, resource disposition explicitly leaves Hold uncancelled, parent terminal and stop proof are absent. Later journal records RESOURCE_LEASE_EXPIRED quarantine and navigation revocation. Outer process teardown and process disappearance do not replace stop/cancel/resource-release protocol evidence.

frame_time_alignment.basis: Same-host monotonic callback receive timestamps; action/guard ROS stamps remain distinct. No video decoding in this audit.
frame_time_alignment.limitation: Frame indexes count actual writer calls and sidecar metadata, not independently inspected visual movement. A status tag is the most recently received status at encoding, not necessarily synchronized to image capture. Full physical stop, PICK completion and smooth coverage do not follow from 39 executing-tagged frames.
